name: netcrossword-live
description: Real-time multiplayer Computer Networks crossword game for classroom learning

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev
scripts.prebuild: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
